agent_explanation: Single body rises and contacts the arena ceiling between steps 625 and 626. Incoming speed ~14.99 m/s with e=0.7 should rebound at ~10.5 m/s, but observed rebound is 35.08 m/s with energy jumping 219.8->722.7 J and no controller work. e=0 still violates, so restitution is not the cause. Likely cause is faulty ceiling boundary collision resolution (impulse sign/error and/or positional correction adding velocity) that injects kinetic energy on a high-speed grazing/penetrating top-wall contact with tiny dt=3.5e-4.
